Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and asks so we can move the security intake and procurement planning forward: 

Recap from today
- Greenline is evaluating an inference layer for real-time pricing & checkout personalization (low-latency, <150ms token latency target).
- Primary value: reduce checkout friction and increase authorization success.

Asks / next steps
1) Confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (name, title, email).
2) Security intake: please share the primary security contact for questionnaire ownership and any existing vendor requirements (e.g., SOC 2, data residency, encryption standards).
3) Systems in scope: can you confirm whether the following are in scope for the initial pilot?
   - Greenline Checkout (public web + mobile SDK)
   - Orders DB (GCP-hosted Postgres)
   - Support tooling (Zendesk)
4) Timeline: preferred decision window and any procurement deadlines.

I've attached a short initial questionnaire to speed the intake — if you can return the parts you have answers for, we'll triage and surface any follow-ups for your security team.

Proposed next meeting: Thu 10/7 or Mon 10/11 — 30 minutes to align on scope and procurement steps.

Thanks,

- Economic buyer: Priya Narang, VP Payments (priya.narang@greenline.com) — will be the final sign-off for commercial terms.
- Procurement lead: Tom Ellis (tom.ellis@greenline.com) — handling standard PO/terms and procurement intake.

Security contact / questionnaire ownership
- Primary security owner for vendor assessments: Carlos Mendez (Director, IT Security) — carlos.mendez@greenline.com. He asked to receive the questionnaire and any sample SOC2 or encryption requirements.

Systems in scope (preliminary)

Timeline

I've attached a partially completed intake with answers for the obvious fields — Carlos will fill in the deeper security responses after your team shares the questionnaire.

Thanks Asha — this is helpful. A couple of notes from our side and a short checklist so Carlos has what he needs to complete the intake quickly.

Decision criteria (what your stakeholders typically ask)
- Latency SLA: 95th pctile overall token latency and steady-state tail behavior.
- Cost per invocation / predictable TCO once scaled.
- Data controls: ability to pin model variants, audit logs, and KMS integration.
- Support & rollout: can we do a progressive rollout with canary and automatic fallback?

Security questionnaire kickoff 
Carlos — to make the intake efficient, could you confirm the following items for the initial scope?
- Which data elements in Orders DB are considered sensitive (PII, payment PANs, tokens)?
- Do you require vendor-hosted logging retention limits or on-prem log forwarding?
- Any regional residency constraints (do orders need to stay in-region)?

Systems & boundaries (proposed)
- In scope: Greenline Checkout (public SDK), Orders DB (GCP), Zendesk support integration (limited metadata).
- Out of scope for pilot: internal fraud tooling, legacy data warehouses.

Can we get Carlos' estimation of how long the detailed questionnaire will take — 3 business days, 1 week? We'll schedule a short kickoff with your security team and bring our security PM and infra engineer.

I'll also attach our lightweight stakeholder mapping template to capture econ buyer, procurement cadence, budget owner, and security approvers. If you like, I can pre-fill it from today's notes.

Thanks — Marissa
